# Launchd Backend Action Map

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `service.launchd.mixin` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/service.yaml` |
| Tags | service, launchd, abstract |

Mixin that wires the launchd-backend action verbs to their
lifecycle definitions. `target` (set by the consuming service) is
the `launchd.<id>` definition; lifecycle defs accept a `definition:`
input that they resolve to a label via the catalog.
